main.title: Summary
text: iOS developer with 6 years of experience shipping consumer apps with millions of users. I lead architecture decisions (MVVM, modularisation), mentor juniors and care deeply about app performance and accessibility.

items.heading: Senior iOS Developer — Example Food Delivery
bullets: Rebuilt checkout flow in SwiftUI; crash-free sessions rose to 99.8%.
Split the monolithic app into 12 Swift Package modules, cutting build time by 35%.
Set up CI/CD with Fastlane and GitHub Actions for weekly App Store releases.

items.heading: iOS Developer — Sample Bank (sample)
bullets: Maintained an Objective-C and Swift codebase for retail banking.
Implemented Face ID login and secure keychain storage.
